request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body production prototype of the standard kett Destined from Mass Effect: Andromeda, faithfully matching the attached finalized game-model sheet by Christopher Cao. Use its SECOND figure, the straight frontal view, as the precise pose authority. One subject and one view only, from top of crest to both complete feet, generous transparent margin of at least 6 percent on all sides. Transparent RGBA background, no floor, no shadow plane, no captions or publisher logos. Preserve the tall slender humanoid shape, gray ridged bone head with high central crest, narrow dark face and recessed small eyes, high curved olive-green armored collar surrounding the neck, paired compact shoulder armor, black segmented abdomen, long narrow olive tabard-like front plate, curved thigh and lower-leg plates, split-toed armored feet, and cyan light cylinders at the upper arms and small cyan circular nodes exactly as seen. Keep the exact number and placement of armor segments, material colors, seams, straps, fingers and limbs. Relaxed static frontal stance matching the reference. No weapon, no floating ring, no Ascendant halo, no spell effect, no changes to original costume. High-quality realistic game-render finish with even neutral illumination and clear silhouette. The attached multi-view sheet is only the model reference, not a composition to copy.
